# pve_ha_resource (Resource)

HA-managed resource (guest) with restart/relocate constraints.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_ha_resource" "example" {
sid = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sid` (String) HA resource ID. This consists of a resource type followed by a resource specific name, separated with colon (example: vm:100 / ct:100). For virtual machines and containers, you can simply use the VM or CT id as a shortcut (example: 100).

### Optional

- `auto_rebalance` (Boolean) HA resource may be migrated during automatic rebalancing (default: 1)
- `comment` (String) Description.
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `failback` (Boolean) Automatically migrate HA resource to the node with the highest priority according to their node affinity  rules, if a node with a higher priority than the current node comes online. (default: 1)
- `group` (String) The HA group identifier.
- `max_relocate` (Number) Maximal number of resource relocate tries when a resource fails to start. (default: 1)
- `max_restart` (Number) Maximal number of tries to restart the resource on a node after its start failed. When reached, the HA manager will try to relocate the resource to an eligible node. (default: 1)
- `purge` (Boolean) Remove this resource from rules that reference it, deleting the rule if this resource is the only resource in the rule (default: 1)
- `state` (String) Requested resource state. (default: started) One of: `started`, `stopped`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `ignored`.
- `type` (String) Resource type. One of: `ct`, `vm`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: sid (also the `terraform import` format).
